name: Apply Ceiling Primer (Spray Only, No Backroll)
intent: Spray primer onto bare drywall ceiling without a backroll pass. Used at QT2/QT3 economy when crew capacity doesn't allow a backroller. Faster but produces a slightly more textured laydown that's acceptable on the ceiling because the finish coat will hide the texture.
doctrine: Single-pass spray rate (575 SF/hr) is ~15% faster than spray+backroll combined effective rate. Source spec gates this to QT2/QT3 only — QT4 requires backroll for primer adhesion uniformity. The wall edge is masked by MOD_SETUP_CEIL_MASK_ADJACENT and a post-spray cut-in is NOT included in this module because the source spec doesn't include one for spray-only ceilings (the spray pattern handles the masked edge cleanly).
